summary: Implemented R6-R10 on the existing two-tab sidebar without touching root selection, storage layout or the apps/terminals list. App now owns the session-only sidebar tab (initialised to projects, never read from or written to storage), passes it plus a Show Files handler to Sidebar, adds the Ctrl+Shift+E showFiles entry to the one shared shortcut registry, the palette action and the help line, and derives the Files header context (owning app name, Misc or Home) from the existing explorerRoot result. Sidebar keeps a local-tab fallback for standalone use, mounts the Files panel on first selection, and renders one memoised projectsRollup() dot on the Projects label and rail icon, aria-hidden so accessible names and role=img counts stay intact. ExplorerPanel shows context and today's folder wording separately with hover text, and saves/restores .body scroll on tab hide/show while resetKey/root changes still reset it. Tests cover every requirement and its listed edge cases. npm run lint and npm run build pass. Full npm test: 706 passed, 2 failed; both are pre-existing baseline failures (App.version.test.tsx and the App.test.tsx footer test still hardcode 2.3.0 while package.json/Cargo.toml/tauri.conf.json are 2.4.0), unrelated to this change and present in the run's baseline check output.
